testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the first-save preview of a solid part ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user sketches a 40 by 25 mm rectangle on the XY datum plane and extrudes it 20 mm ✔ And the unsaved part containing that visible rectangular solid is active ✔ And the first-save preview settings are configured to save an isometric component view ✔ When the user presses Control+S ✔ Then the Save As dialog opens with a proposed part filename selected ✔ And Save Preview Picture is checked ✔ And Active Component Iso View on Save is selected ✔ And the preview area displays a shaded isometric block
